initial_review_items: Some numerical perturbations also changed whitespace, confounding their intended test.
Some probe expected-check annotations were inconsistent with the actual perturbation.
repair_observation: Worker claimed the controller rejected unchanged check definitions. Actual recorded submissions carrying checks all changed requirement wording; the immutable-inventory guard correctly rejected them. The final blocked artifact also rephrased one public requirement. A subsequent general interface simplification will let the controller carry the exact immutable inventory into repair artifacts, without weakening checks or rewriting historical results.
